tasks.title: Harness baseline on the scaffold: coordinate contract, drive scenarios, FD0
tasks.desc: The scaffold already has window.__game (src/debug/hooks.ts) and verify --quick was green on 2026-11-10. Lock the baseline and the coordinate rule (owner inbox: correct coordinates from day 1 with tests). (1) Check the hook contract against docs/GAME_HOOKS.md and fix any gap; without ?debug=1 window.__game.debug must not exist (add a unit test or a scenario that opens the page without debug=1). (2) Add src/geo/projection.ts: lat/lon to world metres and back around one named Delhi origin constant (India Gate, 28.612894 N, 77.229446 E), east +X, north -Z, up +Y, accurate to under 0.5 m within 25 km of the origin (local transverse Mercator or ENU; write the choice to decisions.md as provisional until the architecture sign-off). No mirroring, no axis flips. (3) Unit tests: the origin maps to (0,0); Connaught Place central park (28.6315, 77.2167) lands at x -1246 +/- 25, z -2071 +/- 25 (north-west of the origin); Red Fort (28.6562, 77.2410) lands at x +1129 +/- 25, z -4821 +/- 25 (north-north-east); round trip error under 0.01 m; a point due north has x 0 and negative z. (5) Play script harness/verify/milestones/FD0.js per milestones.json FD0 (real inputs only). (6) quick.json: core = boot_title, hooks_contract, perf_baseline, drive_north; areas mapped to src/car.ts, src/geo/, src/debug/. Notes: this is tooling and tests, no look change.

tasks.title: Architecture options draft for Godot and the composite map (with map repair, lane model and map inspector)
tasks.desc: Mode ARCH_DISCOVERY, now for Godot 4.7 on desktop (Mac and Windows; a web demo maybe later) and the composite map. Write harness/design/ARCH_OPTIONS.md from templates/ARCH_OPTIONS.template.md, using SALVAGE_AUDIT.md 'What Dilli Darshan must do differently', the Godot baseline perf numbers (P0-009), the style candidates, the owner's answers from sittings 1 and 2 (three characters, guns and fights, on foot anywhere, the composite map districts and layout), and the leading game design options. Decisions, 2 to 4 options each, every number marked estimate or measured: renderer (Forward+ vs Mobile; lighting at city scale: baked lightmaps vs SDFGI vs VoxelGI vs no GI with tuned ambient); physics (Jolt vs Godot Physics; VehicleBody3D vs a custom raycast vehicle; CharacterBody3D for on foot; collider shapes per tile: concave trimesh vs HeightMapShape3D plus road meshes); language (GDScript vs C#, which blocks the web export and needs the .NET build and a dotnet SDK, vs GDExtension in C++ or Rust for heavy runtime code); the offline bake pipeline outside Godot (Node reusing tools/geo/projection.ts, vs Python) and what Godot reads (custom binary tiles parsed in GDScript or GDExtension, Godot resources written by a headless Godot import step, or glTF per tile); coordinates (district frames: a transverse Mercator origin per district plus a translation offset, MAP_REPAIR.md 'District frames and stitching'; float precision at the planned map size: 32-bit floats, a floating origin, or a double precision build); the composite map (district selection file, clip and offset, stitching, connector authoring format and tools, filler between districts, the layout options from DELHI_WORLD.md section 0 with the owner's answers); tile streaming and memory (ResourceLoader threaded loads or WorkerThreadPool, tile size, unload, memory per tile); instancing and LOD (MultiMesh, visibility ranges and HLOD, impostors, occlusion culling); textures (VRAM compression on Mac and Windows, atlases); navigation (navmesh baked per tile offline vs at load; agents for pedestrians, police and traffic); animation and crowds (AnimationTree with skinned characters vs vertex animation in MultiMesh for far crowds, LOD); combat runtime (hitscan, projectiles, ragdolls); traffic AI on the lane model; the map repair layer (refine MAP_REPAIR.md: sources with licence, attribution and quality checks, the pipeline with district selection and stitching, rule engine, auto-repair log, per-tile overrides, elevation solver, verification, pilot districts);
